messages:
alice_sec: We need a canonical pattern for SDK KMS credential loading (env / Vault/SSM / assume-role) before the RBAC change next sprint. Short thread, pls.

ben_infra: Recommendation: default to short-lived creds (STS / Vault leases). Env vars only for local/dev or fully air-gapped on-prem where dynamic creds aren't possible.

carol_devx: SDK should expose modes: env, assume_role (OIDC/STS), secret_manager (vault/aws-ssm). For dev fallback we can show an env example but warn against prod use.

ben_infra: AWS best practice: runtime assumes IAM role via STS, call KMS:GenerateDataKey / Encrypt/Decrypt. No long-lived keys in envs. Log KMS request_id, but never DEKs.

alice_sec: Audit logging requirements: include key_id, operation, requestor principal, KMS request_id, deployment_id, route. NEVER log plaintext DEKs or unencrypted payloads.

dave_product: Product asks: rotation should be mostly transparent and console should let customers BYOK and monitor rotation/rewrap status.

carol_devx: Envelope rotation pattern: store only wrapped DEKs. On rotation run a batched rewrap (ReEncrypt if supported, else Decrypt+Encrypt) with rate limits and a progress endpoint (/v1/keys/rotation-status).

alice_sec: Provider differences: GCP uses short-lived OAuth tokens and CMEK naming; Azure uses AAD tokens and Key Vault rotation policies. Map these to a unified key_identifier in SDK.

ben_infra: Vault/SSM details: prefer Vault transit for wrapping when allowed (keeps secrets out of cloud KMS). For SSM use SecureString and restrict kms:Decrypt to runtime role only.

carol_devx: Proposed SDK config surface (strings): provider, key_identifier, credential_mode (env|assume_role|secret_manager), rotation_window_days. Helpers: assumeRole(), fetchShortLivedCreds(), rewrapBatch(). Keep config explicit about what we never log.

alice_sec: Compromise playbook summary: rotate CMK, rewrap DEKs, revoke role grants, rotate service certs, export recent Decrypt calls for forensic review.

ben_infra: RBAC template: runtime role only gets kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:ReEncrypt on specific key ARN. No kms:CreateKey or ScheduleKeyDeletion.

carol_devx: Action items: ben_infra publish role templates + assume-role examples (EOD Thu); alice_sec add audit schema (Mon); devx draft SDK config PR (next sprint).

security-bot: Policy draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/policies/kms-role-template (preview).

alice_sec: Note for on-prem air-gapped installs: support file-based key provider config with offline rotation tooling and documented rotation steps. Confirm compliance needs now (FedRAMP/PCI => HSM + stricter cadences).
